Time Schedule

Thursday, October 15th: Accreditation and Training, from 18:00 to 20:00  (15 minutes per player)
Friday, October 16th: Qualifications, 6 rounds from 9:30, last round 20:00.
Opening ceremony at 11:30 AM between first and second round, all players must attend in playing uniform.
Saturday, October 17th: LAST 16 11:00 and 13:30 (4 tables) - QUARTERS FINAL 16:00 and 18:30 (2 tables)
Sunday October 18th: 10:00: First Semifinal – 12:00: Second Semifinal – 16:00 FINAL  (1 table)
Podium ceremony

Registrations

By National Federations. 24 athletes.
Registration priority:

1. The title holder. (PLACED).
2. One wild card from the Organizer federation (PLACED).
3. Athletes registered as first (NORMAL 1) by all federations. If the number of 24 is not reached the athletes registered as seconds will be accepted (NORMAL 2). The federations priority order is determined by the nations ranking of the previous EC 3C U25 where each nation is taken only once for the best standing. Federations that did not participate in previous EC will be considered at the end of the nations ranking. Athletes registered as third (NORMAL 3) will also be accepted according to the same criteria until the number of 24 participant is reached. The same procedure will be applied for fourth, fifth etc, until the number of 24 is reached (NORMAL 4,5 etc..).

Federations priority order:
DE-AT-ES-TR-GR-PT-DK-BE-NL-FR-SE- other federations
 

Playing system

8 groups of 3 - best two qualify to last 16

Distance

Groups: 30 points - 50 innings
KO Rounds: 40 points - no innings limit - no equalization

Placed sportsmen

Title Holder: IBRAIMOV Amir (DE) - to be registered as PLACED

Wild Card Organizer (Spain): To be registered as PLACED

€ 150

1st - € 1700,00
2nd - € 800,00
3rd - 3rd - €500,00
5th - 8th - €250,00

HOTEL MONARQUE COSTA NAREJOS
C/Río Dobra, 2
30710 Los Alcázares, Murcia

The prices are per person, and there's an extra fee in case of single occupancy of 36€ that must be added to the price per person and day.

Breakfast - 54,78€
Half Board - 58,30€
Full Board - 62,48€

Also, the room types available are the following:
- Bedroom with double bed (1 person)
- Room with living room, bedroom and extra bed (1 or 2 persons)
- Family rooms with living room and two bedrooms (2 or 3 persons, not available for single occupancy)

The family rooms have an extra fee of 16%, but the third person in the room has a 25% discount

Water is included in meals.

email for reservations: salescnarejos@monarquehoteles.es

Contact for reservation: Sonia Solano +34 601 60 99 62

When making the reservation always quote "European Championship 3-Cushion Billiard"

Deadline for reservations: Monday, September 28th

SHUTTLE SERVICE SPECIAL RATES:
Alicante Airport–CAR transfer: €130
Murcia Airport–CAR transfer: €55
Valencia Airport–CAR transfer: €300
The price is per trip, it’s not round trip.  Doesn’t matter 1 to 4 persons.
Contacts:  carrascobillar@gmail.com    anguita32@gmail.com
Kindly quote flight details upon reservation (Date, time, flight number).
